setup.name: Deploy and verify LVS
setup.query: Use the benchmark-unified-memory skill to orchestrate setup and the vss-deploy-profile skill to deploy the LVS profile with Elasticsearch, VIOS, and the VLM. After all required services are healthy, follow the benchmark skill's project-local CLI setup instructions to configure the deployment against `http://localhost:7777` and verify it with `vss configure check`.
checks: The LVS profile and its required Elasticsearch, VIOS, and VLM services are running and healthy.
The project-local vss CLI is configured for the deployed profile.

setup.name: Download and ingest benchmark videos
setup.query: Use the benchmark-unified-memory and vss-manage-video-io-storage skills. Download the pinned benchmark video resource, ingest every supplied benchmark video into VIOS, and verify the result according to the benchmark skill.
checks: Every supplied dataset video ID has exactly one matching downloaded video.
Every supplied dataset video ID exists as a VIOS video sensor.

setup.name: Generate unified memories
setup.query: Use the benchmark-unified-memory and vss-summarize-video skills. Configure the default unified-memory persistence policy, then summarize every supplied benchmark video exactly once.
checks: Unified memory is configured to persist by default to Elasticsearch and write OpenClaw Markdown notes by default.
Every supplied video has one successfully persisted summary and a corresponding OpenClaw daily-note block whose `Sensor:` context is the exact supplied dataset video ID, not an internal VIOS UUID.
